nicht-du: If this wasn’t you, please contact the person who administers your Ablago right away.
email-geaendert.betreff: Your email address in Ablago has been changed
email-geaendert.text: the email address of your Ablago account has been changed from {alt} to {neu}. From now on you can only sign in with the new address.
passwort-geaendert.betreff: Your Ablago password has been changed
passwort-geaendert.text: the password of your Ablago account has just been changed. All other sign-ins were ended.
einladung.text: an Ablago account has been created for you.
einladung.link: Set your password here (the link is valid for {dauer} and works only once):
zuruecksetzen.text: a new password has been requested for your Ablago account.
zuruecksetzen.link: Set a new password here (the link is valid for {dauer} and works only once):
zuruecksetzen.ignorieren: If this wasn’t you, you can ignore this message. Your current password then stays valid.
verwaltung.betreff_one: Ablago: something new for the administration
verwaltung.betreff_other: Ablago: {anzahl} new things for the administration
verwaltung.einleitung: there is work waiting in the Workbench that only someone who administers Ablago can do:
verwaltung.anmelden: Open Ablago, choose “Administer Ablago” in the user menu and then the Workbench: {link}
verwaltung.anmelden.ohne-link: Open Ablago and choose “Administer Ablago” in the user menu.
verwaltung.fuss: This email comes at most once a day and only when something new has come up.
notfall.benutzt.betreff: Ablago: the emergency access was used
notfall.benutzt.text:
the emergency access of your library was used on {datum} (account {konto}, {email}). Someone entered the emergency code from the emergency sheet and is setting a new password for this account. All sign-ins of the account are being ended, and two-factor sign-in is being reset.

Requested from: {ip}
notfall.benutzt.api_one: The account’s API key stays valid. Revoke it under My account → API keys if you don’t know what it is for.
notfall.benutzt.api_other: The account’s {anzahl} API keys stay valid. Revoke them under My account → API keys if you don’t know what they are for.
notfall.benutzt.nicht-du: If this wasn’t you, someone has your emergency sheet. Sign in with another account that may administer Ablago, deactivate the account or reset its password, download a new emergency sheet under Workbench → Encryption and change the key – it was on the sheet as well.
notfall.fehlversuche.betreff: Ablago: failed attempts at the emergency access
notfall.fehlversuche.text_one: in the last hour a wrong emergency code was entered {anzahl} time, most recently from {ip}.
notfall.fehlversuche.text_other: in the last hour a wrong emergency code was entered {anzahl} times, most recently from {ip}.
notfall.fehlversuche.rat: Guessing is pointless with a code this long, and after every failed attempt input is locked for 30 seconds. If this wasn’t you and the emergency access is allowed from the internet, set it back to “home network only” under Workbench → Sign-in protection.
aufgabenmail.uhrzeit-als-hh-mm: Time as HH:MM in 15-minute steps, e.g. 07:00 or 18:45.
aufgabenmail.wochentage-als-liste-1: Weekdays as a list, 1 = Monday to 7 = Sunday.
aufgabenmail.hallo-du-hast-offene_one:
Hello {name},

you have one open task in Ablago:

{zeilen}

You’ll find all of them under “To do”: {basis}/ablage/eingang

You set the time and weekdays of this summary under “My account”; you can also unsubscribe there.
aufgabenmail.hallo-du-hast-offene_other:
Hello {name},

you have {anzahl} open tasks in Ablago:

{zeilen}

You’ll find all of them under “To do”: {basis}/ablage/eingang

You set the time and weekdays of this summary under “My account”; you can also unsubscribe there.
notfallkontakt.info.betreff: {wer} has added you as an emergency contact
notfallkontakt.info.text: {wer} has added you as an emergency contact for the library “{ablage}” in Ablago. Ablago is a program in which {wer} keeps important documents.
notfallkontakt.info.zugang: This gives you no access, and you don’t need to do anything. If {wer} needs help or something has happened, you are the one meant: then talk to {wer} or the family.
notfallkontakt.info.widerspruch: If you don’t want to be an emergency contact, tell {wer}.
notfallkontakt.fremd: If you don’t know {wer}, someone probably mistyped the address. Then you can ignore this message.
notfallkontakt.geloescht.betreff: You are no longer an emergency contact of {wer}
notfallkontakt.geloescht.text: {wer} has removed you as an emergency contact for the library “{ablage}” in Ablago. You don’t need to do anything.
